cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Let me submit the form tomorrow. Today can be a trial extension. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we can discover whether it harms the form.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. Next time we won't be discussing an untested idea.

mechanism: A presents a first deadline extension as a controlled trial, supplies an interim draft and seeks a record usable in the next request.
confusable: Unlike merely asking for delay, A treats the granted single day as evidence for future exceptions.
comparison: A form trial with draft supplied differs from cafe access under weather conditions.
seedUse: D176-b first extension, one day and future use; S02-b offers the current draft to keep cooperation.
